summary: similarMatch always carries conditions as an array, [] when the registry posts none; a regen must not restore omitempty on that tag.
reason: The generated similarMatch tagged conditions omitempty, so the key vanished from rows with no conditions; same contract as Trial.Phases and the Trial list keys; newSimilarMatch copies into a non-nil slice. Deliberately untouched: internal/source/ctis.go CTISTrial.Countries (no caller outside tests) and every other slice field outside Trial and similarMatch, which was not investigated. Guarded by TestSimilarMatchConditionsKeyAlwaysPresent and TestSimilarMatchKeepsValues.
validated_outcome: The live gap was not reproduced: on unfixed code similar NCT03041571 --limit 50 gave 31 rows with 0 missing conditions and similar NCT07534098 --limit 50 gave 49 rows with 0 missing. The change is proven by the RED to GREEN run (TestSimilarMatchConditionsKeyAlwaysPresent failed in both subtests on omitempty, then passed) and by mutations: M1 (re-add omitempty) fails both subtests, M2 (drop the non-nil copy) fails the nil-Conditions subtest, M3 (drop the Conditions line) fails TestSimilarMatchKeepsValues.
